# TraceAgent

Visual observability platform for multi-agent teams. A primary prompt fans out into
parallel sub-agents; TraceAgent intercepts their structured logs and renders an
interactive execution tree showing exactly how the work decomposed.

## Features

- **Live execution graph** — React Flow + dagre auto-layout; nodes colored by kind
  (agent / tool / llm) and status, animated edges while running. Nodes pop in in
  real time as agents execute — no refresh.
- **Waterfall timeline** — every span on a shared time axis, so parallelism is
  obvious at a glance (overlapping bars = concurrent work).
- **Per-trace rollups** — spans, wall-clock vs. total work, **parallelism factor**,
  token and cost totals.
- **Click-to-inspect** — any node opens its input, output, timing, and log lines.
- **Drop-in SDK** — decorate a function and its calls show up on the tree; parallel
  sub-agents nest correctly with zero manual context-passing.

## Architecture

```
SDK ──POST /v1/events──▶ FastAPI ──NOTIFY──▶ Postgres
                                              │ LISTEN
React EventSource ◀──SSE /v1/stream──── FastAPI
```

- **SDK** (`sdk/`) — Python middleware agents import. Tracks parent/child nesting with
  `contextvars` so parallel `asyncio` sub-tasks land in the right place on the tree.
  Ships batched events asynchronously so tracing never blocks the agent.
- **Backend** (`backend/`) — FastAPI + async SQLAlchemy (psycopg3) + Postgres.
  Ingestion endpoint persists events and `NOTIFY`s; an SSE endpoint holds a `LISTEN`
  connection and streams events to the dashboard live. No WebSocket, no Redis.
- **Frontend** (`frontend/`) — React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Vite. React Flow renders
  the live execution graph; native `EventSource` consumes the SSE stream.

## Data model

```
Trace (one run, root prompt)
 └─ Span (agent | tool | llm | task)   ← tree via parent_span_id
     └─ Event (append-only log line, streams live)
```

## SDK usage

Instrument agents by decorating them. Parallel fan-out is tracked automatically —
each `asyncio` sub-task inherits its parent span via `contextvars`.

```python
from traceagent import TraceClient, log

client = TraceClient(endpoint="http://localhost:8000")

@client.agent("web_search", kind="tool")
async def web_search(query: str) -> str:
    return await search(query)

@client.agent("researcher")
async def research(topic: str) -> str:
    log(f"researching {topic}")        # attaches to the current span
    return await web_search(topic)

@client.agent("planner")
async def planner(prompt: str):
    # three researchers run in parallel — all nest under `planner` on the tree
    return await asyncio.gather(*(research(t) for t in topics))

with client.trace("Write a competitive brief"):
    await planner("Write a competitive brief")
client.flush()
```

Run the full demo: `python sdk/examples/demo_agents.py`.

## Quick start

**Local dev:**

```bash
make install   # venv + deps (incl. SDK) + migrations + npm install
make dev       # Postgres + backend (:8000) + frontend (:5173); Ctrl-C tears down
make demo      # in another shell — generates a live trace you can watch appear
```

**Or the whole stack in containers** (app on http://localhost:8088):

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

See [DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md) for configuration, migrations, and production notes.

<details>
<summary>Manual steps (without make)</summary>

```bash
docker compose up -d db

cd backend
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]' -e '../sdk[dev]'
cp .env.example .env
alembic upgrade head
uvicorn app.main:app --reload          # :8000

cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run dev   # :5173
python ../sdk/examples/demo_agents.py          # optional demo trace
```
</details>

## Tests

```bash
make test   # SDK contextvars/nesting tests + backend ingestion integration tests
```

- `sdk/tests/` — proves parallel sub-agents nest under the right parent purely via
  `contextvars`, plus output/error capture.
- `backend/tests/` — posts events through the real ingestion path and asserts the
  reconstructed tree (needs Postgres up).

## Tech stack

React · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Vite · React Flow · FastAPI · async SQLAlchemy ·
psycopg3 · PostgreSQL (LISTEN/NOTIFY) · Server-Sent Events · Alembic

## Milestones

- [x] **M0** — Scaffold + data model + end-to-end health check
- [x] **M1** — Event schema + ingestion + trace-tree query
- [x] **M2** — Python SDK (contextvars propagation + batched shipping) + demo agents
- [x] **M3** — Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY + SSE streaming
- [x] **M4** — React Flow graph (auto-layout, status colors, live updates, detail panel)
- [x] **M5** — Timeline waterfall, token/cost rollups, polish
